header.function_name: XD01 Cross Dock Part Master Screen

revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Initial Draft: business version of UISS XD01_UISS_Screen_CrossDockPartMaster.xlsx

objective: Give Procurement and the D/S team one place to manage which parts are handled by crossdock and how many cases per day go to each destination, and to send this master to GTOPAS and AP POLE.
One screen with two tabs: Kanban Crossdock Master (part number level) and Export Crossdock Master (part + calculation period + destination level).
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To register crossdock candidate parts (Part No, Period, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day).
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To search and display registered crossdock parts with their status and capacity.
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To change part data and part status (Candidate / Active / Inactive) of a registered part.
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To display the change history of a part.
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: To export the Kanban Crossdock Master to Excel and upload part settings from Excel (Add and Edit).
Kanban Crossdock Master tab: This sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a Procurement account; users with a D/S account open the Export Crossdock Master sub-menu instead.
Export Crossdock Master tab: To split the Max Case/Day of each Active part over destinations (Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam) for the ongoing calculation period.
Export Crossdock Master tab: To display the destination mapping per part and calculation period, including past periods (read only).

Export Crossdock Master tab: To send the changes of the Current and Next period to AP POLE (XD07) and GTOPAS (XD06) with [Sync], and show the Sync Status of each part (worked out from the staging tables).
Export Crossdock Master tab: To export the mapping to Excel and upload the mapping of the ongoing period from Excel.
Export Crossdock Master tab: This sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a D/S account; users with a Procurement account open the Kanban Crossdock Master sub-menu instead.

buttons.name: Tab (Kanban Crossdock Master / Export Crossdock Master)
buttons.function: Switch between the Kanban Crossdock Master tab and the Export Crossdock Master tab.

buttons.name: Add Part
buttons.function: Open the "Add Part Candidate Crossdock" modal (Add Mode), ready to register a new part.

buttons.name: Upload Excel (Kanban Crossdock Master)
buttons.function: Open the "Upload Excel: part settings" modal (Upload Mode).

buttons.name: Export Excel (Kanban Crossdock Master)
buttons.function: Download the Kanban Crossdock Master as .xlsx: sheet "Kanban Crossdock Master" (active filter) and sheet "Upload" (base file for Edit uploads).

buttons.name: Run calculation (Kanban Crossdock Master)
buttons.function: Start the DAD Volume Calculation batch manually. Enabled only when the scheduled run and its 3 auto retries have failed.

buttons.name: Reset
buttons.function: Clear criteria and reset the screen to its initial value.

buttons.name: Search
buttons.function: To retrieve records according to the specified criteria. The criteria are applied only when [Search] is clicked (or Enter is pressed in a text box); Sort by is applied at once.

buttons.name: Part Number link / Edit
buttons.function: Change the screen into edit mode to modify the selected row ("Edit part data" modal).

buttons.name: History
buttons.function: Open the "History setting" modal of the selected part.

buttons.name: Prev / Next
buttons.function: Move to the previous / next page of the result list.

buttons.name: Save
buttons.function: Kanban Crossdock Master tab: Save the part data entered in the Add / Edit modal.; Export Crossdock Master tab: Save the destination mapping of the part.

buttons.name: Cancel
buttons.function: Kanban Crossdock Master tab: Close the Add / Edit modal without saving.; Export Crossdock Master tab: Leave edit mode and discard all changes of the panel.

buttons.name: Close
buttons.function: Kanban Crossdock Master tab: Close the History setting / Upload Excel modal (also the X icon of every modal).; Export Crossdock Master tab: Close the Upload Excel modal without uploading.

buttons.name: Validate file
buttons.function: Save button of the upload: validate the uploaded file and save it (all-or-nothing), then show the success popup.

buttons.name: OK
buttons.function: Close the success popup.

buttons.name: Run calculation (Mapping)
buttons.function: Start process 2 (mapping destination) of the XD05 DAD Volume Calculation batch manually. Enabled only when the scheduled run and its 3 auto retries have failed.

buttons.name: Sync
buttons.function: Call SP STG sync (refer 5.24): the staging rows with Sync Status 0 (AP POLE: Current and Next period; GTOPAS: Current period) get the run ID, then the RPA parent flow starts. Whatever the filter shows. The label shows the number of parts, e.g. Sync (21).

buttons.name: Upload Excel (Mapping)
buttons.function: Open the "Upload Excel: destination mapping" modal. Enabled only when the ongoing calculation period is selected.

buttons.name: Export Excel (Mapping)
buttons.function: Download the mapping as .xlsx: sheet "Export Crossdock Master" (active filter) and sheet "Upload" (base file for the upload).

buttons.name: Expand (arrow)
buttons.function: Open / close the Destination Mapping panel of the part row.

buttons.name: Edit mapping
buttons.function: Change the Destination Mapping panel into edit mode (ongoing period only).

buttons.name: Split evenly
buttons.function: Divide Max Case/Day evenly over all destinations of the part.

buttons.name: Add destination
buttons.function: Add a new destination row (destination not selected, Case/Day 0).

buttons.name: Remove destination
buttons.function: Remove the destination row (trash icon).

screen_mode_remarks: 1) Prev is disabled on the first page and Next on the last page.
2) A user logged in with a read-only account sees [View] instead of [Edit] and cannot use Add Part / Upload Excel / Save. TBD: which accounts are read-only is not defined yet.
3) Run calculation is shown as D (disabled) by default; it is enabled only when the scheduled DAD Volume Calculation has failed 3 times (auto retry).
4) Sync is enabled only when a staging table has a row with Sync Status 0 (AP POLE: Current / Next, GTOPAS: Current), not limited to the listed rows.
5) Split evenly is shown only in edit mode when the part has more than one destination row.
7) Prev is disabled on the first page and Next on the last page.
8) Run calculation is enabled only when the scheduled XD05 DAD Volume Calculation (process 2) has failed 3 times (auto retry); otherwise disabled with message no. 30 as tooltip.
6) A user logged in with a read-only account cannot use Edit mapping, Sync or Upload Excel. TBD: which accounts are read-only is not defined yet.
9) '-' = the button is not on the tab of the mode.

items.group: <Kanban Crossdock Master - Add Part / Edit Part Data Modal>

items.name: Modal title
items.initial: Add: 'Add Part Candidate Crossdock'; Edit: 'Edit part data'

items.name: Step indicator
items.description: Step 1 Part Candidate (Part No), step 2 Pcs/Case & Max Case/Day, step 3 Total Pcs/Day; a step gets a check when its items are filled.

items.name: Status
items.validation: Add: always Candidate. Edit of a Candidate part: Candidate or Active. Edit of an Active / Inactive part: Active or Inactive
items.description: Add: locked to Candidate (tooltip 'New parts are automatically Candidate'). Edit: a Candidate part can become Active (ongoing period); an Active or Inactive part can be Active or Inactive; no part goes back to Candidate.

items.name: Part No
items.validation: Must exist in Part Master and not yet be registered (no duplicate Part No)
items.description: Add: lists parts of Part Master not yet registered (Part No + name, contains search, arrow keys / Enter / Esc). Edit: locked.

items.name: Part Name
items.description: Autofilled from the selected Part No.

items.name: Period
items.validation: Add: the ongoing period or the next period. Edit: locked
items.description: Add: the ongoing period (default) or the next period, marked (ongoing) / (next); the part takes effect from it. Edit: locked (part of the key), tooltip message no. 10. A part of the next period is view only until that period becomes the ongoing one.

items.name: Min MAD
items.description: Minimum MAD of the part, entered by the user. Reference value compared with the MAD result of the calculation. Mandatory on Add and Edit; tooltip of disabled [Save] = message no. 15.

items.name: Max Case/Day
items.description: Locked until Pcs/Case is filled (tooltip 'Enter Pcs/Case first'). Edit: cannot be less than the total Case/Day already mapped in the ongoing period (destination mapping); otherwise the field is marked red, message no. 14 is shown and [Save] is disabled.

items.name: Mapped Case/Day (current period)
items.description: Edit mode, Active parts only (Candidate / Inactive parts have no mapping). Total Case/Day of all destinations of the part in the ongoing period (' · no destination yet' when none); red when Max Case/Day is below it. Shows the lowest allowed Max Case/Day before Save.

items.name: Total Pcs/Day
items.description: Calculated: Pcs/Case x Max Case/Day, recalculated on every change.

items.name: Cancel
items.description: Closes the modal without saving.

items.name: Save
items.description: Enabled only when Part No, Min MAD, Pcs/Case > 0 and Max Case/Day > 0 are filled and, in Edit, Max Case/Day is not below the mapped total. Refer Operation Description 5.4 / 5.5.

items.name: Close (X)
items.description: Same as [Cancel].

items.name: Part identity
items.description: Part No · Part Name of the selected row.

items.name: Event title
items.description: e.g. 'Part registered', 'Status changed'. Latest event marked with a blue dot.

items.name: Changed field (old → new)
items.description: Field name, old value struck through, new value.

items.name: User
items.description: User who made the change.

items.name: Close
items.description: Closes the modal.

items.name: Template columns
items.description: Part Number, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Status, Upload (A/E), Period (same names and order as sheet 'Upload' of Export Excel).

items.name: Rules per upload value and status
items.description: Add / Edit / Status rules; Candidate status cannot be changed by upload, Active <-> Inactive allowed, nothing can become Candidate.

items.name: Upload file
items.description: File checks and row validation are done by the batch (UISS-Batch XD02 Cross Dock Part Master Upload).

items.name: Download template .xlsx
items.description: Downloads the empty upload template. TBD: template file location.

items.name: Close
items.description: Closes the modal without uploading.

items.name: Validate file
items.description: Save button of the upload. Refer Operation Description 5.7.

items.name: Success message
items.description: Display message no. 9 (Add / Edit) or no. 11 (upload).

items.name: OK
items.description: Closes the popup.

items.name: Calculation period
items.description: Options: All periods / every calculation period; the ongoing one is marked '(ongoing)', the next one '(next)'. The label shows (ongoing) / (past) / (all). Calculation periods are created by the calculation batch; the latest period created is the ongoing period and earlier ones become past. A new period starts empty: the mapping of the previous period is not copied. Every Active part is listed with its Max Case/Day from Kanban Crossdock Master (the quota) but no destination yet (Total Case/Day 0, 0%), until the D/S user assigns it by Edit mapping or Upload Excel.

items.name: Part Number
items.description: Suggestions = registered Part Numbers. Placeholder 'e.g. PART-B'. Combined with the other criteria by AND.

items.name: Sync Status
items.description: Options: All / Non Sync / Sync. Non Sync = the part + period has a staging row with AP POLE or GTOPAS Non Sync.

items.name: Reset
items.description: Returns every criterion to its initial value (Calculation period = ongoing, Sync Status = Non Sync).

items.name: Search
items.description: Applies the criteria to the result list. Typing or selecting a criterion alone does not change the list; Enter in a text box = [Search].

items.name: Last mapping calculation
items.description: Date-time of the last successful run of process 2 (mapping destination) of the XD05 DAD Volume Calculation batch (one date per batch run).

items.name: Failed badge
items.description: 'Scheduled run failed 3x'; shown when the scheduled run and its 3 auto retries have failed.

items.name: Run calculation (Mapping)
items.description: Manual trigger of process 2 (mapping destination) of the XD05 DAD Volume Calculation batch. Refer Operation Description 5.19 and Screen Mode remark 8).

items.name: Sync (n)
items.description: n = parts + periods with a row Sync Status 0 in the staging tables (AP POLE: Current and Next; GTOPAS: Current), whatever the filter. Disabled when n = 0. Refer Operation Description 5.24.

items.name: Upload Excel (Mapping)
items.description: Disabled for a past period or All periods (tooltip message no. 23). Refer Operation Description 5.17.

items.name: Export Excel (Mapping)
items.description: Refer Operation Description 5.18.

items.name: Period
items.description: Calculation period of the row. Stored as YYYYMM (e.g. 202609), displayed as Mon YYYY.

items.name: Expand (arrow)
items.description: Opens / closes the Destination Mapping panel of the row.

items.name: Total Case/Day (used / quota)
items.description: Used (bold) = sum of Case/Day of all destinations of the part and period; quota = Max Case/Day of the part in Kanban Crossdock Master.

items.name: Pcs/Day
items.description: Calculated: Pcs/Case x Total Case/Day.

items.name: Percentage
items.description: Calculated: Total Case/Day / Max Case/Day (Max Case/Day). Never above 100%: Save, upload and the Max Case/Day edit in Kanban Crossdock Master are blocked above the limit.

items.name: Sync Status
items.source: Stg Appole Kanban / Stg Appole Export, Stg Gtopas

rows: A new part always starts as Candidate. Active / Inactive is decided by the monthly calculation: average MAD of the last months ≥ Min MAD → Active, otherwise Inactive.
A Candidate part can become Active on the screen; Active ↔ Inactive is allowed; a part can never go back to Candidate.

A new part is registered for the ongoing month (default) or the next month and takes effect from that month. The period cannot be changed later. A part of the next month can only be viewed until that month starts.
The total case/day of all destinations must not exceed the Max Case/Day of the part. A lower total is allowed and shown as "n case/day left".
Max Case/Day cannot be reduced below the case/day already mapped; the mapping has to be reduced first.
A destination appears only once per part and must exist in the destination master (GTOPAS).
Each monthly calculation creates a new period that starts from the calculated proposal; previous periods are kept view-only.
Any change to a part or its mapping (screen or upload) marks the part "Not yet sent".
One Sync sends every Active part that is not yet sent or failed, plus the parts that became Inactive (sent as "stop crossdock").
A part is "Sent" only when both GTOPAS and AP POLE received it. If one target fails, the part is "Failed" with the reason; if it is changed while sending, it goes back to "Not yet sent".
An Excel upload is saved only when the whole file is valid; otherwise nothing is saved and the user gets a report with the rows to correct.
Every change is kept in the history for 24 months.

operation.text: 5.1 - 5.10: Kanban Crossdock Master tab. 5.11 - 5.20: Export Crossdock Master tab. 5.25: table changes of every save.

items: The sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a Procurement account.
Search criteria: 'Part Number' and 'Part Name' blank, 'Status' = All, 'Sort by' = Newer to Older.
Show all parts of the Part List sorted by last update time, newest first, 25 rows per page, page 1.
If no part is registered at all, hide the table and display message no. 2 with [Upload Excel] and [Add one part].
The criteria are applied when the user clicks [Search] (or presses Enter in 'Part Number' / 'Part Name'); changing a criterion alone does not change the list. 'Sort by' is applied at once.
'Part Number' and 'Part Name' match by 'contains', case-insensitive; 'Status' matches exactly. All criteria are combined with AND.
Clicking [Search] or changing 'Sort by' or 'Rows per page' returns the list to page 1.
If no row matches, hide the table and paging and display message no. 1 with [Reset filter].
Counter 'N parts' is counted over the whole filtered result, not only the current page.
Total Pcs/Day = Pcs/Case x Max Case/Day.

Open the 'Add Part Candidate Crossdock' modal. 'Status' = Candidate and locked (a new part is always Candidate); 'Period' = the ongoing period (default) or the next period: the part takes effect from it.
'Part No' lists only parts of Part Master that are not registered in Part List yet, so a part cannot be registered twice.
Selecting a Part No autofills 'Part Name'. 'Max Case/Day' is locked until 'Pcs/Case' is filled.
[Save] is enabled only when Part No, Min MAD (whole number, 0 or more), Pcs/Case > 0 and Max Case/Day > 0 are filled; otherwise its tooltip shows message no. 5, 15, 6 or 7 for the first missing item.
If the Part No was registered by another user in the meantime, display message no. 3. Stop.

Save the part in the Part List with status = Candidate and period = the selected period. When the ongoing period is selected and XD05 has already made the next period (between day D and the Period Rollover), insert the same row for the next period too, so the next XD05 run calculates the part. A Candidate part is not sent (no staging row).
Insert the change history in change history (refer 5.6).
Close the modal, reset the Part Number / Part Name / Status filters, sort Newer to Older and display message no. 9. The new part is shown at the top. Table changes: refer 5.25.

operation.text: User clicks [Cancel] or the X icon: close the modal without saving.
User clicks the 'Part Number' link or [Edit] on a row.

items: Open the 'Edit part data' modal with the saved values. 'Part No' and 'Period' are locked. 'Status': a Candidate part can stay Candidate or become Active; an Active or Inactive part can be Active or Inactive; no part goes back to Candidate.
Only rows of the ongoing period can be edited. A part registered for the next period has no [Edit] until its period becomes the ongoing period.
'Min MAD' (mandatory, whole number 0 or more), 'Pcs/Case' and 'Max Case/Day' can be changed; 'Total Pcs/Day' is recalculated.

Active part only: below Max Case/Day show 'Mapped Case/Day (current period): n' = total Case/Day of the part in destination mapping for the ongoing period (' · no destination yet' when none), so the user sees the lowest allowed Max Case/Day before Save.

Max Case/Day cannot be less than the total Case/Day already mapped to destinations in the ongoing period (destination mapping); otherwise the field is marked red, message no. 14 is shown below Pcs/Case & Max Case/Day and [Save] is disabled. The user must first reduce the mapping in Export Crossdock Master (same rule as upload check 9).
If the record was changed by another user after it was opened, display message no. 4. Stop.
Check again that Max Case/Day is not below the mapped total of the ongoing period; if it is, display message no. 14. Stop.
Update Part List, updated by and last update time. Active -> Inactive also deletes the mapping of the period (destination mapping). Call SP STG write for the staging rows (refer 5.24 and 5.25).
Insert the change history in change history (refer 5.6).
Close the modal, move the part to the top of the list and display message no. 9. Table changes: refer 5.25.
The history comes from the records inserted when a user adds or changes a part.
User clicks the clock icon on a row: open 'History setting' with the change timeline of the part, newest first.
Each event shows the title, date-time, field name, old value (struck through) → new value and user.

The history records every change of the part: Add / Edit by screen, Upload, mapping changes (add, change or remove a destination) and the calculation. The sync is in the staging tables (not shown here). A part without history shows message no. 12.

operation.text: Retention: the history of a part is kept; there is no housekeeping job.

items: User clicks [Upload Excel]: open the modal with the template columns, the rules and the file area (.xlsx, max 5 MB, max 5,000 rows).
Edit rows use sheet 'Upload' of the Kanban Crossdock Master Export Excel as base file (pre-filled with Upload (A/E) = E). Sample: sheet 'Upload Kanban Crossdock Master'.
Status rule: a Candidate part's status cannot be changed by upload; Active <-> Inactive can be changed; no part can be changed to Candidate.

User clicks [Validate file] (save button of the upload): the file is passed to the upload batch; validation, saving (all-or-nothing) and logging follow UISS-Batch "XD02 Cross Dock Part Master Upload Batch".
When the upload is completed, close the modal and display message no. 11. When it is rejected, show the batch result (error list) - refer UISS-Batch.
Changed parts get staging rows and show Sync Status Non Sync.
User clicks [Export Excel]: download Crossdock_Kanban_Master_YYYYMMDD.xlsx.

Sheet 'Kanban Crossdock Master': rows of the active filter and sort (all pages) with Part Number, Part Name, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Total Pcs/Day, Status, created time, created by, last update time, updated by. Information only. Sample: 'Export Kanban Crossdock Master'.
Sheet 'Upload': every registered part, columns as sheet 1 (Part Number, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Status, Upload (A/E) = E, Period YYYYMM). Base file for Edit uploads.
If the file cannot be created, display message no. 13.

The DAD Volume Calculation batch runs on its own scheduler (set in system master) with 3 auto retries. It compares the average MAD of each part with Min MAD and sets the part status to Active or Inactive (refer UISS-Batch XD05 DAD Volume Calculation (process 1)).
The result list header shows 'Last DAD calculation' (last successful run) and, when the scheduled run and its 3 retries have failed, the badge 'Scheduled run failed 3x'.
[Run calculation] is enabled only in that failed state; otherwise it is disabled with message no. 17 as tooltip.

User clicks [Run calculation]: start the batch. When it completes, update 'Last DAD calculation', hide the badge, refresh the list and display message no. 16. When it fails, the batch logs the error (all-or-nothing) and the button stays enabled.

XD05 writes the staging rows of the new period through SP STG write (refer UISS-Batch XD05 4.11); a change from Active to Inactive gives Export DELETE rows (0), so the part is sent by the next [Sync].

Active part. Only Active parts can be mapped in the Export Crossdock Master sub-menu.
Inactive part. Not mapped in the Export Crossdock Master sub-menu.
The part + period has a row with Sync Status 0 in the AP POLE staging (Kanban, Export) or in the GTOPAS staging.
Every staging row of the part + period is sent (Last Sent = latest send time of the target).

operation.text: Active and Inactive parts are synchronised (not Candidate). A Save after [Sync] writes new staging rows: the part is Non Sync again until the next [Sync].

Sync Status rule: a part becomes Non Sync when SP STG write writes a staging row, that is when a value AP POLE or GTOPAS holds changes: Pcs/Case or Max Case/Day (Kanban), a destination or its Case/Day (Export; GTOPAS only when a destination appears or disappears), Active -> Inactive (Export DELETE 0). Min MAD, a Candidate part and a save without change write no row.

items: The sub-menu is opened only for users logged in with a D/S account.
Search criteria: 'Calculation period' = ongoing period, 'Part Number' blank, 'Sync Status' = Non Sync.
Ongoing period: list every Active part of Part List, with its destinations of destination mapping for that period (a part without destinations is listed with Total Case/Day 0).

A new period starts empty: the mapping of the previous period is not copied. Every Active part is listed with its Max Case/Day from Kanban Crossdock Master (the quota) but no destination yet (Total Case/Day 0, 0%), until the D/S user assigns it by Edit mapping or Upload Excel.
Past period: list every part that has rows in destination mapping for that period, whatever its current status. 'All periods' lists both.
The criteria are applied when the user clicks [Search] (or presses Enter in 'Part Number'); changing a criterion alone does not change the list.
'Part Number' matches by 'contains', case-insensitive; 'Calculation period' and 'Sync Status' match exactly. All criteria are combined with AND.
[Upload Excel] and Export Excel follow the period of the applied criteria.
If no row matches, hide the table and display message no. 18.
With the default Sync Status = Non Sync, parts already sent are hidden until the filter is changed.
Total Case/Day = used / quota (sum of Case/Day of the part and period / Max Case/Day); Pcs/Day = Pcs/Case x used.
Percentage = Total Case/Day / Max Case/Day; it never exceeds 100% because the total cannot go above Max Case/Day (Save, upload and the Max Case/Day edit in Kanban Crossdock Master are blocked).

The list is paged: 25 rows per page by default (25 / 50 / 100), with paging information and [Prev] / [Next]. A part with its Destination Mapping panel counts as one row. [Search], Reset and a change of Rows per page return to page 1.
User clicks the arrow on a row: open the panel with the allocation note and the destination table (Destination, Case/Day, Pcs/Day, Percentage). All items are read only.
Ongoing period: show [Edit mapping]. Past period: show message no. 22 instead; the mapping cannot be changed.
A part without destination shows message no. 19.
Copy the mapping into a draft; Destination and Case/Day become editable, a trash icon appears per row and [Add destination] is shown.
The Destination list hides destinations already used by another row of the same part (one destination per part).
[Add destination] adds a row with 'Select destination' and Case/Day 0.
[Split evenly] (more than one row): Case/Day of each row = floor(Max Case/Day / number of rows); the remainder is added +1 per row from the first row. Example 24 / 3 = 8 / 8 / 8; 25 / 3 = 9 / 8 / 8.
The allocation note is recalculated on every change.
the total Case/Day is above Max Case/Day (show message no. 20);
the part has no destination row; or
a row has no destination selected (show message no. 21).
A total below or equal to Max Case/Day is allowed; below is shown as '{n} case/day left'.
If the mapping was changed by another user after edit mode started, display message no. 25. Stop.
Save the draft per destination in destination mapping: update the Case/Day of a kept one, insert a new one, delete a removed one (see Data Edit Mapping).

Call SP STG write per added, changed or removed destination: Export ADD / EDIT / DELETE (0), a GTOPAS row when the destination appears or disappears for the part, the Kanban header (operation type 5) when the Kanban did not change (refer 5.24). A Save without change writes no row. The total Case/Day may not exceed Max Case/Day (message no. 20).
Record every added, changed or removed destination in the change history (old and new Case/Day).
Leave edit mode and show the saved mapping. Table changes: refer 5.25.

operation.text: User clicks [Cancel] or closes the panel: discard the draft.

items: Call SP STG sync (refer 5.24): the AP POLE rows of the Current and Next period and the GTOPAS rows of the Current period with Sync Status 0 get Sync Status 1, sync time and the run ID. Candidate parts are never sent.
Start the RPA parent flow with the run ID (refer UISS-Batch XD06 / XD07). Display message no. 27.
With the default filter Non Sync the parts leave the list; select Sync Status = Sync or All to see them.

operation.text: Interface functions (one per target system; refer UISS-Batch XD06 and XD07).

items: The parent flow checks the run: with GTOPAS rows (a part becomes Active or Inactive, a destination is added or removed) XD06 runs first and XD07 starts only when GTOPAS succeeded; without GTOPAS rows XD07 runs at once.

XD06 adds or deletes the part + destination rows of the run on GTOPAS WVJA5204. XD07 uploads the files of the run from the views V appole upload export / _KANBAN in the order export PRE, KANBAN, export post.
The bots write nothing back to NSP; the result comes by the notification e-mail (SUCCESS / FAILED).

operation.text: When the e-mail says FAILED, the D/S team clicks [Re-send last Sync]: the rows of the last run ID are sent again in the same order (the bot sets values, so a repeat is safe).

Interface method: one Power Automate parent flow per run starts XD06 (RPA on GTOPAS WVJA5204) and XD07 (RPA upload of LLM9Q880 / LLM9Q910 to AP POLE); the RPA reads only the staging tables and the views (refer UISS-Batch XD06 / XD07).

items: [Upload Excel] is enabled only when the ongoing calculation period is selected; otherwise it is disabled with message no. 23 as tooltip.
The modal shows the 6 template columns (as sheet 'Upload' of Export Excel), the upload rules and the file area (.xlsx, max 5 MB, max 5,000 rows).
Base file: sheet 'Upload' of Export Excel with the ongoing period selected. A part in the file gets its mapping updated per destination (refer XD03); parts not in the file are not changed.

User clicks [Validate file] (save button of the upload): the file is passed to the upload batch; validation, saving (all-or-nothing) and logging follow UISS-Batch "XD03 Part and Destination Mapping Upload Batch". Template sample: sheet 'Upload Mapping'.
When the upload is completed, close the modal and display message no. 24. When it is rejected, show the batch result (error list) - refer UISS-Batch.
Changed parts get staging rows and show Sync Status Non Sync.
User clicks [Export Excel]: download Crossdock_Export_Master_<period>_YYYYMMDD.xlsx (<period> e.g. Sep_2026 or All_periods).

Sheet 'Export Crossdock Master': rows of the active filter, one row per destination (a part without destination gives one row with blank destination columns). Columns: Period, Part Number, Part Name, Destination Code, Pcs/Case, Dest Case/Day, Total Case/Day (used), Max Case/Day (quota), Dest Pcs/Day, Pcs/Day, Sync Status AP POLE, Sync Status GTOPAS, Last Sent AP POLE, Last Sent GTOPAS, created time, created by, last update time, updated by (audit of the mapping row). Information only. Sample: sheet 'Export Mapping'.

Sheet 'Upload': every Active part of the ongoing period, columns Part Number, Destination Code, Dest Case/Day, Total Case/Day (used), Max Case/Day (quota), Upload (A/E); one row per destination, and one blank row (Upload (A/E) = A) for a part without mapping. Empty for a past period or All periods. Upload (A/E) = E for a mapped destination.
If the file cannot be created, display message no. 26.

The XD05 process 2 (mapping destination) batch runs on its own scheduler (set in system master) with 3 auto retries. It creates the new calculation period and its destination mapping (refer UISS-Batch XD05 DAD Volume Calculation (process 2)).
The section header shows 'Last mapping calculation' (last successful run) and, when the scheduled run and its 3 retries have failed, the badge 'Scheduled run failed 3x'.
[Run calculation] is enabled only in that failed state; otherwise it is disabled with message no. 30 as tooltip.

User clicks [Run calculation]: start the batch. When it completes, update 'Last mapping calculation', hide the badge and display message no. 29. When it fails, the batch logs the error (all-or-nothing) and the button stays enabled.

rows: Kanban Crossdock Master data, part number + period level (key Part No, period). Holds Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day and status.
Mapping data, part number + calculation period + destination level (key Part No, period, destination code). period = CHAR(6) YYYYMM, e.g. 202609; displayed as 'Sep 2026'.
Destination Master (existing, read only). Crossdock uses destination code and destination name only.
Only Active parts are mapped in the ongoing period.
Created by the calculation batch. Ongoing (latest period): mapping can be edited and uploaded. Past: read only.
AP POLE Kanban rows (LLM9Q910 format) and the header of the part (operation type 1 to 5); refer 5.24.
AP POLE Export rows (LLM9Q880 format); refer 5.24.
GTOPAS rows (part + destination Add / Delete); refer 5.24.

operation.text: The sync status is not kept on Part List: every value change is a row of Stg Appole Kanban, Stg Appole Export or Stg Gtopas with its Sync Status. change history keeps the screen history.

items: Names: sub-menu Part List = Kanban Crossdock Master (Procurement), sub-menu Mapping per Destination = Export Crossdock Master (D/S). Page title Crossdock Master. Export Excel: Crossdock_Kanban_Master_YYYYMMDD.xlsx (sheet Kanban Crossdock Master) and Crossdock_Export_Master_<Period>_YYYYMMDD.xlsx (sheet Export Crossdock Master).
Kanban Crossdock Master (former Part List) has a period like the Export Crossdock Master: Part List is kept per Part No + period (Status, Pcs/Case and Max Case/Day of that month).

Kanban Crossdock Master screen: new search criterion Calculation period (All periods / periods, default the ongoing period) and new first column Period. Rows of a past period: Part Number and [Edit] not available, [History] available. Add Part: into the ongoing period (default) or the next period.

Periods: Past = view only; Current (M) = changed by screen and upload; Next (M+1) = made by XD05 on day D (system master), view only until day 1. On day 1 the Period Rollover (XD05 process 3) makes Next the Current period.

Order Type per destination row (system master '**', 'C', '9', 'V'): the same destination may have two rows in a period when the order type differs; key Part No + period + destination code + order type. Export Crossdock Master: new column Order Type (combobox of the system master) after Destination (CD); Save is blocked when a destination + order type is used twice ("The same destination is used twice with the same order type").
Export Excel / Upload of the Export Crossdock Master: new column Order Type after Destination Code (sheet 1 and sheet Upload).

Max Case/Day of a period may not be below the mapped total of that period (message 14): to lower it, D/S first reduces the destinations on the Export Crossdock Master, then changes Max Case/Day on the Kanban Crossdock Master.
[Sync] and Sync Status are per part and period (Part List key Part No + target system + period): XD07 sends the Current period first, then the Next period; XD06 uses the Current period only.
Every save calls the stored procedure SP STG write once per changed value, in the same transaction and after the master tables are updated. A save without a changed value writes nothing.

Kanban (Stg Appole Kanban): a change of Pcs/Case or Max Case/Day of an Active part writes a row with the values after the change (ACTION EDIT); Candidate -> Active and a part of a new period write ACTION ADD. operation type compares the new Max with the last Max sent to AP POLE (same period, else the latest earlier period): 1 = Max down, 2 = Max up, 3 = Max same, 4 = never sent.

Export (Stg Appole Export): one row per added (ADD), changed (EDIT) or removed (DELETE, Max Shipping Box (RCS) 0) destination + order type. Active -> Inactive writes DELETE (0) for every destination of the part.

GTOPAS (Stg Gtopas): a row only when the destination appears or disappears for the part (any order type) and GTOPAS does not have that state yet. A Case/Day change or an order type change of a destination that stays writes no GTOPAS row.

Header: an Export change of a part + period without an unsent Kanban row writes the Kanban header with ACTION KEEP and operation type 5 (current Kanban values, not uploaded). So every part of a run has one Kanban row that sets its upload order.

Superseded: a new row of a key marks the older unsent row of the same key Sync Status 2. A value set back to the value already sent for the period gets Sync Status 2 too (nothing to send). Keys: Kanban period + Part No; Export period + NSP part no + destination code + order type; GTOPAS period + P no + destination code.
NSP keeps the end state valid before the save: total Case/Day of the destinations <= Max Case/Day of the part in the period (XD01 messages 14 and 20, XD02 / XD03 checks).

[Sync] calls SP STG sync with a new run ID (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS). It calculates nothing: it locks the staging tables for a moment (a save at the same time waits), sets Sync Status 0 -> 1 with sync time and sync RUN ID on the AP POLE rows of the Current and Next period and on the GTOPAS rows of the Current period, and sets the System Master parameter last sync date appole. Then it starts the RPA parent flow with the run ID.

Upload files of AP POLE (views): export PRE (LLM9Q880, order 1) = Export rows of the parts whose Kanban row of the run has operation type 1; KANBAN (LLM9Q910, order 2) = Kanban rows of the run with operation type 1 to 4; export post (LLM9Q880, order 3) = every other Export row of the run. Inside a file, per part, rows going down or DELETE (ROW order 1) come before rows going up or ADD (ROW order 2). An empty file is not made. File name <template>_<RUN ID>_<order>_<name>.xls.

RPA parent flow: a run with GTOPAS rows (a part becomes Active or Inactive, a destination is added or removed) runs XD06 first and XD07 only when GTOPAS succeeded; a run without GTOPAS rows runs XD07 only. The Period Rollover runs XD06 only.

The robots write nothing back to NSP; the result comes by the notification e-mail. When it says FAILED, the D/S team clicks [Re-send last Sync] before the next [Sync]: the same run ID, the same rows and order.
Rows of a past period that were not sent before the Period Rollover are never taken again: every selection has a period condition.

Sync Status per part + period: AP POLE Non Sync while Stg Appole Kanban or Stg Appole Export has a row with Sync Status 0, else Sync; GTOPAS Non Sync while Stg Gtopas has a row with Sync Status 0, else Sync. Last Sent = latest sync time of the target.

Rules and simulation: deliverables/function_list_v2/erd/proposal_staging_sync (Proposal_Tables_Staging_Per_Target.xlsx, simulation/Staging_Header_Order.html, simulation/Staging_Per_Target_Full_Flow_Simulation.xlsx).

operation.text: Every save on the screen writes in one transaction. Add = insert a row, Edit = update a row, Delete = delete a row. A save without a changed value adds no history and no staging row. Columns: refer Data Map.

The part row: Status, Min MAD, Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Total Pcs/Day, updated by / last update time.

Active -> Inactive: 1 DELETE row per destination GTOPAS has.
1 row per new destination + order type of the part and period.

The row of a removed destination.
1 row per added, changed or removed destination, event MAPPING, field Case/Day.
1 row per added (ADD), changed (EDIT) or removed (DELETE, 0) destination.
1 row when a destination appears or disappears for the part (any order type).

The older unsent row of the same key: Sync Status Superseded.

last sync date appole = time of the click.
The rows of the last run ID are sent again (refer 5.16 c). No row is added.

Written by the upload batch, source UPLOAD: XD02 for Kanban Crossdock Master, XD03 for Export Crossdock Master (refer UISS-Batch).
Given a new part, when Procurement saves it, then its status is Candidate and its period is the ongoing month unless the next month is chosen.
Given an Active part, when Procurement opens Edit, then the period is locked and the status can only be Active or Inactive.
Given Max Case/Day 24 and destinations totalling 24, when D/S adds 1 case/day to a destination, then Save is blocked with the over-capacity message.
Given a part with 20 case/day mapped, when Procurement changes Max Case/Day to 18, then Save is blocked until the mapping is reduced.
Given 3 changed Active parts and 1 part that became Inactive, when D/S clicks Sync, then 4 parts are sent and the Inactive part is sent as "stop crossdock".
Given GTOPAS receives a part and AP POLE fails, when the sending ends, then the part is Failed with the AP POLE reason.
Given an upload file with 1 invalid row out of 100, when validated, then nothing is saved and the report lists that row.
Given the scheduled calculation failed 3 times, when the user clicks Run calculation, then the calculation runs and the last success date is updated.
